subject: learning/code-toolbin
statement: toolbin resolves a sibling pyxis CLI to a runnable file by release pin or one-shot go build of ./cmd/<tool>, with PATH only as last resort.
intent: Share one acquisition path so implement-now, plangate, and later callers do not reimplement carina lookup.
rationale: Duplicated PATH-or-temp-build logic drifted and still missed source-mode checkouts.
fit_criterion: Unit tests cover source build into .pyxis/bin, PATH fallback, missing tool, canceled context, and defective config.
